verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings reborn in civilized countries are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti aviññātāresu milakkhesu.
verses.english: while those reborn in the borderlands, among uneducated foreigners, are many.
